text:
Maria: quick sync — we need a minimal, production-safe set of KV/prefix cache metrics for the console dashboards. runtime + infra input pls.
Alex: sgtm. what are we thinking as the core metrics?
Maria: minimal set i propose: hit_count, lookup_count, eviction_count, reuse_count (by workload), warmth_percentage, and a small histogram for reuse_size. also meta tags: model_family, tenant_tier (prod/staging), workload_type (chat/embed/batch).
Cheng: we should avoid high-cardinality tenant ids on main metrics. use tenant_tier + sampled tenant_id (1%) for debugging only.
Sam: agree on sampling. also correlate miss spikes with request latency → want p50/p95 latency alongside miss_rate.
Maria: noted. rough metric names for telemetry team:
```
# counters
redwood_kv_prefix_lookups_total{model_family,tenant_tier,workload_type}
redwood_kv_prefix_hits_total{model_family,tenant_tier,workload_type}
redwood_kv_prefix_evictions_total{reason,model_family}
redwood_kv_prefix_reuse_total{workload_type,model_family}
# gauges/histograms
redwood_kv_prefetch_warmth_gauge{model_family}  # fraction warm
redwood_kv_reuse_size_bytes_histogram{workload_type}
```
Alex: nice. two infra concerns: 1) ingestion volume if we tag model_version and tenant_id. 2) retention window for per-tenant breakdowns.
Cheng: propose compromise: export full tags at 1% sample rate, export coarse tags (model_family, tenant_tier) at 100%. add an explicit metric redwood_kv_sampled_tenant_count to know sample coverage.
Sam: for dashboards we should surface: overall hit_rate = rate(hits)/rate(lookups) (5m), per-model_family hit_rate, eviction reasons over time (stacked), reuse heatmap by workload_type x tenant_tier, and top sampled tenants by miss_rate (debug panel).
Maria: agreed. can someone draft PromQL snippets for panels? i'll bundle in the dashboard PR.
Alex: quick PromQLs:
```
# overall hit rate (5m)
sum(rate(redwood_kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_kv_prefix_lookups_total[5m]))
# per model_family hit rate (5m)
(sum by (model_family) (rate(redwood_kv_prefix_hits_total[5m]))) / (sum by (model_family) (rate(redwood_kv_prefix_lookups_total[5m])))
# eviction reasons over 1h
sum by (reason) (increase(redwood_kv_prefix_evictions_total[1h]))
```
Cheng: + add a metric for cold-priming: redwood_kv_prefetch_attempts_total and success_count. want to know how many prefetches actually warmed the cache.
Maria: good call. add those. also we should tag prefetch type: proactive vs reactive.
Sam: ops question: what sample rate for sampled tenant_id? 0.5% might be too low for smaller tenants. propose adaptive sampling: min 1 event/min sampled per tenant, otherwise 1%.
Alex: adaptive ok, but complexity goes up. start with static 1% and iterate if customers complain.
Maria: dev plan: 1) runtime PR to emit metrics with coarse tags + sampled tenant_id flag (Alex owns). 2) infra ingestion changes to honor sample flag and route sampled metrics to long-tail analytics (Cheng owns). 3) dashboard PR with panels + drilldowns for sampled tenants (Maria owns). 4) add alert: drop in global hit_rate > 10% sustained 15m (Sam owns).
ops-bot: deploy v3.12 started by infra-cicd (job 4821) :rocket:
Alex: i'll start the runtime patch tomorrow, i'll include the histogram for reuse_size and prefetch success metrics.
Cheng: will prototype ingestion pipeline changes on staging, will also add meter to count sampled_tenant_payloads.
Maria: i'll open a dashboard skeleton PR and attach example panels + the PromQL above. will CC all.
Sam: FYI add a panel correlating p95 latency on text_generation_route with miss_rate, helps quantify customer impact.
Maria: thanks all — ping here if anyone needs data schema or wire format. i'll drop a short RFC later today with concrete metric names + tag set.
Alex: noted. thanks.
Cheng: thumbs up.
Maria: action items set. closing thread after RFC posted. :white_check_mark:
